_doc: Instagram posting plan. FOUR sections, one category each, every single day.
AUTHORITATIVE SPEC, owner, 2026-08-14. Categories are decided by the DAYS OF THE WEEK
a trip leaves and comes back on — not by how many nights it runs. The rule lives in
pipeline/trip_shape.py and nowhere else; this file no longer carries night bands or
depart_dow/return_dow for the sections, because they would be a second copy of the
rule that could drift. Run `python pipeline/trip_shape.py` to see it prove itself.
LONG WEEKEND        out Thu/Fri, back Sun/Mon, 2-4 nights. Four legal shapes.
EXTRA LONG WEEKEND  out Wed-Fri, back Sun-Wed, 4-7 nights. Eight legal shapes.
WEEK-ISH            out Thu-Sat, back the following Thu-Mon, 5-11 nights. Fifteen.
CHEAPEST OUT OF CLT everything else — two-week trips, Tuesday departures, Saturday
to Tuesday, every awkward shape. Defined as leftovers on purpose:
that is what makes it honest.
Evaluation stops at the first match, so a fare carries exactly ONE category and can
never appear twice on a board. Sections render top to bottom in the order below.
NEVER AN OVERPAYMENT, ON ANY SLIDE. min_discount is 0.12 for the three trip-shape
sections and 0.0 for CHEAPEST — zero, not negative.
A section that cannot find 14 shows fewer and prints the real count. Never padded.
A section with zero rows renders no slide at all.
A city may appear in more than one section on different dates, never twice in one
section, and the same exact flight never twice in one post.
Tiers live in config/tiers.json and control EXPOSURE, not eligibility.
`shapes` and `week` below are KEPT because render_reel.py still resolves a daily shape.

week.angle: A full week away, round trip, verified this morning.

weekend.angle: Out Thursday or Friday, back Sunday or Monday. A real long weekend, and you burn no vacation days.

urgent.angle: Long weekend shaped, leaving inside three weeks. Short window, real prices.

friday.angle: Expedia's 2026 Air Hacks Report puts Friday as the cheapest day of the week to book a flight, about 3% under Sunday, and the cheapest day to fly overall, up to 8% under a Sunday departure. Worth knowing: for US domestic routes specifically that report still has Tuesday as the cheapest day to actually fly, roughly 14% under Sunday.

twoweek.angle: The big one. Honeymoon, anniversary, the trip you keep putting off.

0.note: Monday. Peak booking day. The money post.

4.note: Friday. Cheapest day to book and fly, per Expedia 2026.

5.note: Saturday. PLAN: city guide carousel, build trust, do not sell. The guide renderer does not exist yet, so this still posts a normal board. Flip content to guide once it does.

6.note: Sunday. PLAN: inspiration plus a Monday teaser. Renderer does not exist yet, so this still posts a normal board.

alternating._doc: Every other Sunday the two week post replaces the usual Sunday content. Twice a month max, on purpose, so it stays special. Parity is on the ISO week number.

content_mix_target._doc: Four sections, every post, up to 14 rows each across two slides. A section with zero rows renders no slide.

_dow: 0=Mon 1=Tue 2=Wed 3=Thu 4=Fri 5=Sat 6=Sun. The `shapes` block below still uses depart_dow/return_dow because render_reel.py resolves a daily shape from it. The four `sections` deliberately do NOT: their identity is the weekday rule in pipeline/trip_shape.py, and a second copy here could drift from it.

sections.angle: Out Thursday or Friday, back Sunday or Monday. 2 to 4 nights. Built for a normal 9 to 5.
A weekend with a couple of days bolted on. Out Wednesday to Friday, back Sunday to Wednesday. 4 to 7 nights.
A real week off. Out Thursday to Saturday, back the following Thursday through Monday. 5 to 11 nights.
Odd days off. These are cheap because the dates are awkward, and we say so. Every other shape lands here.
